summary: Plan, track and report humanitarian projects using logframes, workplans and monitoring tools. Explore this five-day foundation course.
lede: Humanitarian project management turns response priorities into activities that teams can plan, monitor and report. It is for humanitarian project officers, coordinators and programme staff who connect plans with field delivery; practice includes drafting needs summaries and logframes, tracking indicators and expenditure, following up partners, and using monitoring evidence and community feedback to record adjustments and report progress.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is for humanitarian staff who coordinate project activities, support partner delivery, track results or prepare project updates. It suits you if your role links field implementation with programme, finance, logistics or accountability work.
audience: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Officers
prerequisites: Designed for foundation-level humanitarian project officers, coordinators and programme staff involved in planning, implementation, monitoring or reporting. No coding or programming is required.
